```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# Define main directory
main_dir <- "/Users/song/Documents/Research/HPC/dfs2/mrsec/FFssFF"

# Define step for analysis
step <- 10  # Process every 10th frame

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(readxl)
library(scales)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)

# Required packages
required_packages <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "gridExtra")

# Function to safely load packages
load_packages <- function(packages) {
    for (package in packages) {
        if (!requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE)) {
            install.packages(package)
            library(package, character.only = TRUE)
        } else {
            library(package, character.only = TRUE)
        }
    }
}

# Load required packages
load_packages(required_packages)

# Define base theme
plttheme <- theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
    text = element_text(size=12),
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = 0.3),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent")
)
```

```{r plot_CG_contacts, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=8.0, dpi=1100}
# Text size control - Must be defined before sourcing script
plot_title_size <- 10
axis_title_size <- 10
axis_text_size <- 6
legend_title_size <- 8
legend_text_size <- 6

# Define text theme
text_theme <- theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = plot_title_size),
    axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
    legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
    legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size)
)

# Combine themes
pltthemetemp <- plttheme + text_theme

# Control settings
save_plots <- FALSE
pltsavedir <- file.path(main_dir, "CG_analysis/contact_analysis/output/")
plot_dpi <- 1100
plot_width <- 6.5
plot_height <- 8.0

# Define script path
script_path <- file.path(main_dir, "Plotting/plot_contact_analysis.R")
source(script_path)
```
